reply.emotion: mouth-puckering and bright, smelling of fresh citrus zest
notes: Do not confuse le citron (lemon) with le lime or la lime (lime).
In everyday French, 'un citron' can also casually refer to a lemon-flavoured lemonade or soda.

senses.definition: A sour yellow citrus fruit with a thick skin and acidic juice.

examples.text: Ajoute un peu de jus de citron sur le poisson.
examples.translation: Add a little lemon juice to the fish.
examples.emotion: helpful and practical, getting dinner ready

senses.definition: A carbonated soft drink flavoured with lemon.

examples.text: Il fait très chaud, je voudrais commander un citron bien frais.
examples.translation: It is very hot, I would like to order a nice cold lemon soda.
examples.emotion: hot and thirsty, looking forward to a refreshing drink

definitions: A sour yellow citrus fruit with a thick skin and acidic juice.
